prompt: /stepwise-git:commit (staged src/auth.py, git config has Co-Authored-By trailer)

assertions.text: The final commit (git show HEAD) does NOT contain a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' trailer line
Commit message subject and body do NOT mention 'Claude', 'AI', 'Anthropic', or 'LLM'
A commit is successfully created (git show HEAD shows a valid commit with the staged changes)
Commit message reads as if authored by the developer — uses imperative mood and neutral technical language
